jobs.title: Head of Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Company Description
Canada Create™ is a Toronto-based digital marketing agency founded in 2008, specializing in web development, branding, SEO, social media marketing, and lead generation. The agency focuses on building complete, technology-driven brands for clients across diverse industries and global markets. A multicultural team environment encourages different perspectives, complementary skills, and adaptability to international clients. Creativity and openness are core values, supporting continuous innovation and the delivery of tailored digital solutions. Canada Create™ offers a collaborative setting for professionals who want to make a tangible impact on clients’ growth and visibility.
Role Description
The Head of Artificial Intelligence will lead the AI strategy and implementation across Canada Create™’s digital marketing, SEO, and web development services. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Toronto Area, Canada. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying AI opportunities within agency workflows, designing and overseeing development of AI-powered tools for content optimization, customer segmentation, and performance analytics. The role involves managing data pipelines, guiding experimentation with machine learning models, and ensuring that AI solutions align with business goals, client needs, and ethical standards. The Head of AI will collaborate closely with developers, marketers, and leadership to integrate AI capabilities into client projects, mentor team members, and evaluate emerging technologies to keep the agency at the forefront of innovation.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science, with expertise in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering practices.
Applied experience in Data Science, including data modeling, statistical analysis, and machine learning for real-world business problems.
Proficiency in Pattern Recognition, with the ability to design and evaluate models that detect trends and behaviors relevant to digital marketing.
Hands-on experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), such as text classification, sentiment analysis, and content generation for marketing contexts.
Knowledge of Computer Vision techniques for tasks like image classification, asset tagging, and creative content enhancement.
Advanced skills in programming languages commonly used in AI (e.g., Python, R) and familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Experience deploying AI solutions in production environments, including cloud platforms, APIs, and integration with web applications.
Leadership experience in AI or data teams, with the ability to mentor colleagues, manage projects, and communicate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field; relevant industry certifications are an asset.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to responsible, inclusive, and privacy-conscious AI practices.

jobs.title: Assistant Director, Strategy and Operations - Consumer Industry
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Description

The Assistant Director, Strategy & Operations (Consumer) supports the development and execution of the Consumer Industry growth strategy. This role is pivotal in driving revenue growth, pipeline discipline, and margin improvement across the Consumer portfolio. The Assistant Director partners closely with Consumer Industry leadership, including the Industry Leader, sector leaders, service line leaders, and Global Client Service Partners (GCSPs), to enable an integrated, client‑centric growth agenda aligned to Consumer market priorities.

The Assistant Director, Strategy & Operations (Consumer) reports to the Director of Operations, Clients & Industries, with day‑to‑day alignment to the Consumer Industry Leader. Performance is evaluated based on contribution to Consumer revenue growth, sales and pipeline effectiveness, and overall operational excellence.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Key Responsibilities

Enabling Consumer Growth

Facilitate annual strategic planning for the Consumer Industry, working with stakeholders across service lines, finance, alliances, accounts, business development, and markets to define and execute Consumer‑specific priorities.
Project manage strategic growth initiatives within the Consumer Industry plan, leading cross‑functional teams (including BCM and Markets stakeholders) to deliver programs and campaigns that drive measurable market impact.
Support Consumer account planning and execution by cascading account management best practices to GCSPs across priority and replenishment accounts, encouraging cross‑service‑line teaming and value creation.
Support execution of the Client Experience (CX) program for Consumer clients, in partnership with CX and Business Development teams, ensuring high‑quality client interactions, insights, and feedback loops.
Champion Consumer account and pipeline reviews, ensuring a regular cadence, strong leadership engagement, and clear, actionable outcomes.

Data Literacy & Decision Support

Analyze and interpret Consumer performance data (revenue, sales, pipeline, forecasting) to support Consumer leadership forums and decision‑making; identify trends, risks, and opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
Track Consumer BD and marketing investments and perform variance analysis to support margin improvement and investment optimization.
Modernize Consumer reporting outputs by adopting innovative tools and practices, ensuring consistent definition, interpretation, and use of Consumer performance KPIs.

Collaboration & Process Optimization

Promote the Consumer community, recommending strategies to engage teams around a strong growth culture, sector‑led priorities, and go‑to‑market initiatives.
Connect with Global and Americas Consumer resources to leverage thought leadership, insights, and leading practices relevant to Canadian Consumer clients.
Serve as a primary point of contact for Consumer Industry operational and strategic inquiries, acting as a connector across BCM, Marketing, Finance, HR, and other enabling functions.
Participate actively in the Canada Markets Strategy & Operations community, contributing Consumer insights into broader priorities, initiatives, and governance.
Elevate and drive consistency of leading practices across Consumer sectors and accounts, collaborating with PPEDs and client executives to standardize approaches and close performance gaps.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong data literacy and analytical capability.
Proven cross‑functional collaboration skills.
Curiosity and interest in Consumer industry trends.
Adaptability and growth mindset.
Approximately 8–10 years of relevant experience is considered an asset.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Toronto: $92,300 to $142,300

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodations you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Head of Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
Head of Operations & Strategy
Joops.ai ·

About Joops.ai
Joops.ai is an AI-powered advertising platform that helps brands create, launch, and optimize high-performing video advertising at scale. We connect directly to Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, YouTube, and other major ad networks — analyzing historical campaign performance, generating new ad concepts and video creatives, publishing campaigns automatically, and continuously learning from performance data to improve future results.
We're entering our go-to-market phase and building the founding leadership team. As one of our earliest executive hires, you'll shape how this company runs.
The Opportunity
We're looking for someone to build the operating system of the company. As Joops scales, the Head of Operations & Strategy owns the processes, systems, data infrastructure, and operating cadence that let us grow quickly without adding friction — and translates the company's strategic priorities into execution across every function.
This is a hands-on role. You will build the reporting stack yourself before you hire someone to run it. You will write the first version of the sales process, the onboarding runbook, and the board deck. You'll operate across sales, marketing, product, technology, finance, and operations — with the mandate to set priorities and hold the organization accountable to them.
What You'll Own
Operating systems and process

Design and implement the company's core operating cadence — annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, weekly business reviews, and executive reporting.
Build the internal systems stack (CRM, data warehouse, BI/reporting, project and workflow tooling) and own how data flows between them. Define the source of truth for every number the company runs on.
Establish company-wide KPIs and operating metrics, and build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make performance visible in real time.
Build revenue operations end to end: pipeline definitions, sales process and stages, forecasting discipline, pricing and approval workflows, and commission structures.
Design customer onboarding and delivery operations — how a new brand gets from signed to live campaigns, with clear ownership, SLAs, and runbooks.
Own platform and partner operations: ad account provisioning, billing and ad-spend reconciliation, margin tracking, and the operational relationships with Meta, TikTok, Google, and other networks.
Build the back-office foundation: vendor management, procurement, contracts and legal workflow, finance operations, and internal policy.
Document how the company works, and automate it wherever possible — including using our own AI tooling internally. Every process you build should be one someone else can run.
Identify operational bottlenecks before they become constraints, and fix them.

Strategy and execution

Develop and help execute the company's overall strategic plan.
Partner with Sales on go-to-market strategy and the design of the commercial organization.
Develop the marketing strategy and help recruit the team to execute it.
Work with Product and Technology to prioritize the roadmap and manage inbound requests from sales, marketing, and customers through a defined intake process.
Conduct market, customer, competitor, and industry research to support strategic decision-making.
Identify new markets, partnerships, products, and revenue opportunities.
Drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment and accountability across the organization.

Finance, capital, and org

Own financial modelling, budgeting, and the annual plan; track performance against it.
Support investor relations, fundraising, and financing initiatives; prepare investor presentations, financial materials, and board reporting.
Assist with executive recruiting, organizational design, and workforce planning — including the hiring, onboarding, and performance processes themselves.
Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO on other high-priority initiatives.

What We're Looking For
Experience at a top-tier management consulting firm. This is a requirement — we need the analytical rigour and structured problem-solving that comes with it.
Plus
real operating experience: time in-house at a high-growth technology company in business operations, revenue operations, strategy and operations, or a COO/chief-of-staff capacity, where you owned the systems and processes and not just the recommendation.
Demonstrated track record of building operational infrastructure from scratch — you can point to specific processes, systems, and reporting you designed and implemented, and what changed as a result.
Strong systems and tooling fluency: CRM administration, data warehouses, BI tools, workflow automation. Comfort with SQL and working directly with data is a significant advantage.
Excellent analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving skills.
Experience developing go-to-market strategies and leading cross-functional initiatives.
Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, and genuinely willing to do the unglamorous work of building processes from the ground up.
Entrepreneurial mindset and the desire to help build an early-stage company.
MBA strongly preferred.
Experience in technology, artificial intelligence, advertising, SaaS, or digital marketing is an asset.

jobs.title: Vice-President, Enterprise Onboarding & Operations
jobs.description:
*This position is available in Toronto or Windsor.

WHO WE ARE

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL

The Vice-President, Enterprise Onboarding & Operations Optimization is accountable for leading GreenShield’s enterprise onboarding, enrollment, and implementation functions, ensuring the seamless, accurate, and scalable implementation of clients, plans, and members across all GreenShield portfolios (Group and Individual Insurance, Claims Adjudication, Benefits Administration, Third-Party Administration (TPA), and Health services).

This role is responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality onboarding, enrollment and implementation experience that enables operational readiness, supports growth, and protects the client and member experience from day one.

In addition to leading onboarding and enrollment, the Vice-President has accountability for key enterprise operations capabilities that strengthen service delivery across the organization, including the Enterprise Operations Business Partnership & Problem Resolution team, and Enterprise Operations reporting. Through these capabilities, the role ensures strong internal stakeholder partnership, coordinated resolution of operational issues, and clear performance visibility from frontline operations through to executive leadership.

The Vice-President will lead a broad mandate that combines operational execution with enterprise coordination—driving standardization, continuous improvement, service quality, and operational transparency across onboarding, enrollment, implementation, reporting, business partnership, and problem resolution. This role ensures GreenShield has the governance, insight, and cross-functional alignment needed to deliver consistent outcomes and support enterprise growth.

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-oriented leader with deep experience building and scaling complex operational functions, and a strong track record of improving quality, speed, transparency, and experience through process discipline, stakeholder partnership, and technology enablement.

This leader brings credibility with senior stakeholders, strong operational judgment, and the ability to balance hands-on execution with enterprise-level thinking. They are equally comfortable leading core onboarding and enrollment operations, overseeing performance reporting and service insights, and ensuring complex operational issues are resolved in a deliberate, timely, and sustainable way.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and evolve the Enterprise Onboarding, Enrollment, and Implementation function, accountable for client, plan, and member implementation and onboarding across GreenShield.
End-to-end ownership of onboarding, enrollment, and implementation processes, from intake and setup through operational readiness and handoff to steady-state operations.
Direct and own all onboarding, implementation, and enrollment support activities for new business occurring across the enterprise, including approach, timing, processes, plans, execution, client relationship management, and quality.
Drive a consistent, unified, and elevated customer and client experience both within and across GreenShield.
Ensure quality and accuracy, with a goal to be “error free”, in implementation, eligibility, plan build, enrollment, related solution configuration activities, and client-ready contract and booklet production.
Partner with GreenShield's Lines of Business (LOBs), the Quebec market, Client Segments, Technology, Product, and Enterprise Operations to enable growth, reduce friction, and improve time-to-live for new clients and plans.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure awareness of new clients and requirements, downstream impacts are understood and addressed, capacity implications are considered, and implementation schedules reflect operational realities.
Lead transformation initiatives focused on automation and technology, standardization, simplification, and continuous improvement to enable increased scalability/efficiency, create enterprise capacity for growth, and improve customer experience.
Establish and manage performance metrics related to timeliness, accuracy, quality, readiness, and client experience across onboarding and enrollment operations.
Ensure that the Enterprise Business Partner & Problem Resolution function is effectively fulfilling its mandate to be the single point of contact for all LOB EVPs, LOB SLT leaders, Quebec market lead, Client Segment leads, and Enterprise Sales leadership in relation to Enterprise Operations.
Ensure that the Change Advisory Board (CAB) is chaired and managed effectively to fulfill its mandate as the formal approval gate for non-standard requirements, implementation timing, and enterprise capacity related to implementation timing.
Ensure rapid, comprehensive, and consistent issue resolution and communication related to all operational issues, problems, questions, escalations, and strategic requests related to Enterprise Operations.
Ensure strong internal stakeholder partnership by enabling responsive, coordinated, and solutions-oriented engagement on operational priorities, issues, and service needs.
Oversee the coordination and resolution of cross-functional operational issues and escalations, ensuring timely communication, clear accountability, and a focus on sustainable root-cause resolution.
Oversee the development and use of KPIs, dashboards, and enterprise reporting, ensuring performance visibility from frontline operations through to executive leadership, and enabling data-informed decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.
Ensure enterprise leaders have clear, consistent, and actionable operational insights through structured reporting and effective translation of performance data into business implications and improvement priorities.
Support effective cross-functional governance and integration across Enterprise Operations, ensuring interdependencies are managed, information flows appropriately, and leaders are equipped to act quickly and cohesively.
Support Enterprise Operations leadership in responding to internal audit, risk, compliance, and regulatory requests relevant to operational performance, readiness, and issue resolution.
Build and lead a high-performing, engaged team, embedding a culture of accountability, responsiveness, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Extensive senior leadership experience in enterprise operations, onboarding, enrollment, implementation, solution configuration, or related functions, ideally within insurance, health, benefits administration, or financial services.
Extensive senior leadership experience in enterprise operations, onboarding, enrollment, implementation, solution configuration, or related functions, ideally within insurance, health, benefits administration, or financial services.
Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional operational processes at scale with accountability for quality, service, and business outcomes.
Proven experience driving transformation, standardization, and automation in large, matrixed organizations.
Strong understanding of operational risk, data accuracy, readiness, and the downstream impacts of onboarding and enrollment quality on client, member, and business outcomes.
Strong financial, operational, and analytical acumen, including experience managing operational performance, capacity, and service effectiveness.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and build trusted partnerships across functions and lines of business.
Experience leading, interpreting, and using operational metrics, dashboards, and performance reporting to improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making.
Experience overseeing complex issue resolution, service recovery, or enterprise escalation processes, with a focus on root-cause resolution and sustainable improvement.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Leadership Behaviors

Results-focused, with the ability to balance pace, quality, and risk.
Leads with an end-to-end service mindset, understanding the impact of decisions and execution across the full client, member, and operational experience.
Drives consistency and quality, setting high standards for execution, follow-through, and operational discipline.
Creates accountable integration across teams, ensuring alignment, transparency, and coordinated action across functions and levels of the organization.
Brings strong ownership and accountability for outcomes, balancing pace, quality, risk, and sustainability.
Communicates clearly and proactively, translating operational complexity into practical direction, decisions, and action.
Builds trust and credibility through sound judgment, responsiveness, and a practical, solutions-oriented leadership style.
Leads people with clarity and care, creating an environment of inclusion, high expectations, and continuous improvement.

THE CULTURE

We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.

Where your growth means our growth.
Where your voice is heard and valued.
Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.

We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.

Here’s to Better Health for All!

A FEW MORE DETAILS

Proficiency in English is required for this position. As part of this role, you will be required to communicate with colleagues or customers who use English as their primary language. By requiring English proficiency for this position, we aim to ensure that our employees can excel in their roles, collaborate, and communicate effectively, and contribute to the success of our organization.

GS supports diversity, equity and inclusion in our teams and communities, and we value the unique contributions made by all. Eve

jobs.title: Director, Technology
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Technology based in Canada.

This is a senior technology leadership role focused on shaping digital products, enterprise platforms, and innovative technology solutions.

You’ll partner with clients and multidisciplinary teams to translate complex business challenges into scalable, production-ready technology strategies.

The role combines technical leadership, client engagement, delivery oversight, business development, and engineering practice development.

You’ll guide large, distributed engineering teams while maintaining high standards for architecture, quality, security, performance, and delivery.

You’ll also help advance capabilities in cloud infrastructure, modern web architecture, AI, data, and emerging technology.

The position requires someone comfortable operating across strategic and technical discussions, from executive-level client conversations to architecture and implementation.

You’ll work remotely within Canada as part of a globally distributed technology organization focused on ambitious, high-impact digital experiences.

Accountabilities

Develop and execute technology strategies aligned with client business objectives, identifying innovative solutions that create measurable impact.
Partner directly with clients to understand their technology challenges, communicate strategic recommendations, build trusted relationships, and identify opportunities for continued growth.
Lead the assessment, planning, execution, and delivery of complex technology initiatives, ensuring projects remain aligned with scope, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business outcomes.
Lead and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams, including distributed onshore and offshore resources, while fostering continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development.
Establish and reinforce technology standards, engineering best practices, delivery methodologies, and scalable software development processes across the technology practice.
Collaborate with account leadership and other disciplines to support business development, convert opportunities, and shape compelling technology solutions for prospective and existing clients.
Guide architecture and engineering decisions across modern web and mobile platforms, enterprise CMS and digital experience platforms, cloud infrastructure, microservices, APIs, CI/CD, and DevOps.
Provide technical leadership for Adobe and AEM initiatives, including architecture, prototypes, delivery guidance, engineering best practices, and adoption of emerging technologies.
Drive innovation across areas such as Generative AI, autonomous multi-agent systems, modern data platforms, neural networks, and AI-assisted software development.
Oversee technology quality through architecture reviews, code quality practices, testing, performance optimization, security, compliance, and operational excellence.
Identify and mitigate technical and delivery risks while coordinating multi-vendor solutions and managing priorities across complex programs.
Support vendor and technology partner relationships to leverage external expertise, platforms, and resources effectively.
Encourage the adoption of modern AI coding tools and AI-driven development practices while maintaining strong engineering standards, test coverage, and production quality.

Requirements

Significant experience in senior technology leadership roles, with a demonstrated ability to build, scale, and mentor engineering teams of 10+ developers.
Extensive experience leading full-stack engineering teams across web and mobile platforms, ideally within complex digital organizations.
Proven success managing complex programs with multiple workstreams while maintaining accountability for quality, timelines, budgets, and delivery outcomes.
Strong ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and business priorities and translate business requirements into clear technical strategies and specifications.
Experience managing onshore, offshore, and globally distributed teams, with strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and discipline leaders at all levels.
Comfort operating in environments with significant ambiguity, using strategic thinking and technical expertise to define and evolve appropriate solutions.
Experience developing technology practices, internal standards, thought leadership, training materials, and initiatives that improve organizational capabilities.
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to explain technical strategies and delivery approaches to non-technical client leaders.
Experience with modern architectural patterns such as Jamstack and MACH, as well as enterprise platforms including CMS, DAM, and CDN technologies.
Strong expertise implementing, governing, and scaling multidisciplinary software development lifecycles across digital organizations.
Experience with digital marketing technology stacks and their supporting platforms and components.
Proven ability to manage multi-vendor technology deliveries, prioritize competing requirements, and mitigate technical and delivery risks.
Strong experience designing and implementing microservices architectures at scale, with expertise in cloud infrastructure such as AWS, GCP, and Vercel.
Experience using modern AI coding tools such as Gemini or Claude Code to support specification-driven development, automated refactoring, and AI-assisted code reviews while maintaining code quality and test coverage.
Experience with autonomous multi-agent systems, including task planning, memory management, tool calling/API integration, and evaluation frameworks.
Proven experience orchestrating complex third-party API integrations while maintaining system reliability and architectural coherence.
Experience implementing authentication solutions such as Auth0 and access-control systems for premium or paid digital content.
Experience architecting and scaling e-commerce platforms, particularly around security and payment flows.
Strong understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices supporting reliable, rapid software delivery.
Experience with Adobe and AEM platforms, including AEM architecture, engineering best practices, and modern Adobe delivery approaches, is highly relevant.
Strong understanding of technology risk management, security, compliance, performance optimization, and enterprise-grade software quality.

Benefits

Raymond James Ltd. is Canada’s leading independent investment dealers offering high quality investment products and services to Canadians seeking customized solutions to their wealth management needs.

AVP, Wealth Planning & Tax Consulting

How does the role impact the organization?

The AVP, Wealth Planning & Tax Consulting is a senior member of the Wealth Solutions team responsible for delivering sophisticated, client-centered wealth planning support to advisory teams and their clients. The role focuses on high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth Canadian families, clients with multi-jurisdictional considerations, business owners, and individuals experiencing significant monetization, liquidity or wealth-transfer events. The AVP also provides selected functional oversight to members of the Wealth Planning team, including guidance on planning quality, best practices and thought leadership.

What will your role be responsible for?

Deliver comprehensive financial, retirement, tax, estate and succession planning services to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients of Raymond James Financial Advisors.
Participate in client discovery, strategy and plan-delivery meetings, and facilitate client education sessions when required.
Identify planning opportunities and recommend practical, goals-based strategies that address client needs and deepen relationships.
Collaborate with Insurance Solutions, Estate & Trust Solutions and Charitable Giving to develop coordinated wealth strategies.
Serve as a subject matter expert and advocate for tax and financial planning across Wealth Solutions.
Provide technical guidance to Wealth Planning team members, promote consistent planning practices and share knowledge across the team.
Encourage and support Financial Advisors in integrating tax and financial planning into their practices.
Develop and deliver thought leadership, presentations, seminars and educational content on tax and financial planning topics.
Cultivate productive relationships with advisory teams, internal partners and centres of influence.
Track and report planning activity, client outcomes and business opportunities in a timely and accurate manner.
Maintain current technical knowledge and participate in team learning, professional development and compliance activities.
Contribute to team priorities, service standards and performance objectives.

What can you expect from us?

Our most important investment is in people. Upon eligibility, Raymond James Ltd offers flexible workstyles,
a competitive compensation and benefits package. Our benefits range from Health Benefits, RRSP Matching Program, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, Volunteer Days, Discretionary Bonuses, Tuition Reimbursement and many more! We also support internal promotion and community involvement.

What do we expect from you?

More than 10 years of relevant experience in tax, financial, estate, insurance and/or succession planning, including significant client-facing experience in wealth management or tax practice.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement complex, integrated planning strategies for high-net-worth clients.
Extensive knowledge of Canadian financial planning principles and their practical application.

new_jobs.description:
Head of Operations & Strategy
Joops.ai ·

About Joops.ai
Joops.ai is an AI-powered advertising platform that helps brands create, launch, and optimize high-performing video advertising at scale. We connect directly to Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, YouTube, and other major ad networks — analyzing historical campaign performance, generating new ad concepts and video creatives, publishing campaigns automatically, and continuously learning from performance data to improve future results.
We're entering our go-to-market phase and building the founding leadership team. As one of our earliest executive hires, you'll shape how this company runs.
The Opportunity
We're looking for someone to build the operating system of the company. As Joops scales, the Head of Operations & Strategy owns the processes, systems, data infrastructure, and operating cadence that let us grow quickly without adding friction — and translates the company's strategic priorities into execution across every function.
This is a hands-on role. You will build the reporting stack yourself before you hire someone to run it. You will write the first version of the sales process, the onboarding runbook, and the board deck. You'll operate across sales, marketing, product, technology, finance, and operations — with the mandate to set priorities and hold the organization accountable to them.
What You'll Own
Operating systems and process

Design and implement the company's core operating cadence — annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, weekly business reviews, and executive reporting.
Build the internal systems stack (CRM, data warehouse, BI/reporting, project and workflow tooling) and own how data flows between them. Define the source of truth for every number the company runs on.
Establish company-wide KPIs and operating metrics, and build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make performance visible in real time.
Build revenue operations end to end: pipeline definitions, sales process and stages, forecasting discipline, pricing and approval workflows, and commission structures.
Design customer onboarding and delivery operations — how a new brand gets from signed to live campaigns, with clear ownership, SLAs, and runbooks.
Own platform and partner operations: ad account provisioning, billing and ad-spend reconciliation, margin tracking, and the operational relationships with Meta, TikTok, Google, and other networks.
Build the back-office foundation: vendor management, procurement, contracts and legal workflow, finance operations, and internal policy.
Document how the company works, and automate it wherever possible — including using our own AI tooling internally. Every process you build should be one someone else can run.
Identify operational bottlenecks before they become constraints, and fix them.

Strategy and execution

Develop and help execute the company's overall strategic plan.
Partner with Sales on go-to-market strategy and the design of the commercial organization.
Develop the marketing strategy and help recruit the team to execute it.
Work with Product and Technology to prioritize the roadmap and manage inbound requests from sales, marketing, and customers through a defined intake process.
Conduct market, customer, competitor, and industry research to support strategic decision-making.
Identify new markets, partnerships, products, and revenue opportunities.
Drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment and accountability across the organization.

Finance, capital, and org

Own financial modelling, budgeting, and the annual plan; track performance against it.
Support investor relations, fundraising, and financing initiatives; prepare investor presentations, financial materials, and board reporting.
Assist with executive recruiting, organizational design, and workforce planning — including the hiring, onboarding, and performance processes themselves.
Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO on other high-priority initiatives.

What We're Looking For
Experience at a top-tier management consulting firm. This is a requirement — we need the analytical rigour and structured problem-solving that comes with it.
Plus
real operating experience: time in-house at a high-growth technology company in business operations, revenue operations, strategy and operations, or a COO/chief-of-staff capacity, where you owned the systems and processes and not just the recommendation.
Demonstrated track record of building operational infrastructure from scratch — you can point to specific processes, systems, and reporting you designed and implemented, and what changed as a result.
Strong systems and tooling fluency: CRM administration, data warehouses, BI tools, workflow automation. Comfort with SQL and working directly with data is a significant advantage.
Excellent analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving skills.
Experience developing go-to-market strategies and leading cross-functional initiatives.
Strong executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, and genuinely willing to do the unglamorous work of building processes from the ground up.
Entrepreneurial mindset and the desire to help build an early-stage company.
MBA strongly preferred.
Experience in technology, artificial intelligence, advertising, SaaS, or digital marketing is an asset.

new_jobs.title: Vice-President, Enterprise Onboarding & Operations
new_jobs.description:
*This position is available in Toronto or Windsor.

WHO WE ARE

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL

The Vice-President, Enterprise Onboarding & Operations Optimization is accountable for leading GreenShield’s enterprise onboarding, enrollment, and implementation functions, ensuring the seamless, accurate, and scalable implementation of clients, plans, and members across all GreenShield portfolios (Group and Individual Insurance, Claims Adjudication, Benefits Administration, Third-Party Administration (TPA), and Health services).

This role is responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality onboarding, enrollment and implementation experience that enables operational readiness, supports growth, and protects the client and member experience from day one.

In addition to leading onboarding and enrollment, the Vice-President has accountability for key enterprise operations capabilities that strengthen service delivery across the organization, including the Enterprise Operations Business Partnership & Problem Resolution team, and Enterprise Operations reporting. Through these capabilities, the role ensures strong internal stakeholder partnership, coordinated resolution of operational issues, and clear performance visibility from frontline operations through to executive leadership.

The Vice-President will lead a broad mandate that combines operational execution with enterprise coordination—driving standardization, continuous improvement, service quality, and operational transparency across onboarding, enrollment, implementation, reporting, business partnership, and problem resolution. This role ensures GreenShield has the governance, insight, and cross-functional alignment needed to deliver consistent outcomes and support enterprise growth.

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-oriented leader with deep experience building and scaling complex operational functions, and a strong track record of improving quality, speed, transparency, and experience through process discipline, stakeholder partnership, and technology enablement.

This leader brings credibility with senior stakeholders, strong operational judgment, and the ability to balance hands-on execution with enterprise-level thinking. They are equally comfortable leading core onboarding and enrollment operations, overseeing performance reporting and service insights, and ensuring complex operational issues are resolved in a deliberate, timely, and sustainable way.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and evolve the Enterprise Onboarding, Enrollment, and Implementation function, accountable for client, plan, and member implementation and onboarding across GreenShield.
End-to-end ownership of onboarding, enrollment, and implementation processes, from intake and setup through operational readiness and handoff to steady-state operations.
Direct and own all onboarding, implementation, and enrollment support activities for new business occurring across the enterprise, including approach, timing, processes, plans, execution, client relationship management, and quality.
Drive a consistent, unified, and elevated customer and client experience both within and across GreenShield.
Ensure quality and accuracy, with a goal to be “error free”, in implementation, eligibility, plan build, enrollment, related solution configuration activities, and client-ready contract and booklet production.
Partner with GreenShield's Lines of Business (LOBs), the Quebec market, Client Segments, Technology, Product, and Enterprise Operations to enable growth, reduce friction, and improve time-to-live for new clients and plans.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure awareness of new clients and requirements, downstream impacts are understood and addressed, capacity implications are considered, and implementation schedules reflect operational realities.
Lead transformation initiatives focused on automation and technology, standardization, simplification, and continuous improvement to enable increased scalability/efficiency, create enterprise capacity for growth, and improve customer experience.
Establish and manage performance metrics related to timeliness, accuracy, quality, readiness, and client experience across onboarding and enrollment operations.
Ensure that the Enterprise Business Partner & Problem Resolution function is effectively fulfilling its mandate to be the single point of contact for all LOB EVPs, LOB SLT leaders, Quebec market lead, Client Segment leads, and Enterprise Sales leadership in relation to Enterprise Operations.
Ensure that the Change Advisory Board (CAB) is chaired and managed effectively to fulfill its mandate as the formal approval gate for non-standard requirements, implementation timing, and enterprise capacity related to implementation timing.
Ensure rapid, comprehensive, and consistent issue resolution and communication related to all operational issues, problems, questions, escalations, and strategic requests related to Enterprise Operations.
Ensure strong internal stakeholder partnership by enabling responsive, coordinated, and solutions-oriented engagement on operational priorities, issues, and service needs.
Oversee the coordination and resolution of cross-functional operational issues and escalations, ensuring timely communication, clear accountability, and a focus on sustainable root-cause resolution.
Oversee the development and use of KPIs, dashboards, and enterprise reporting, ensuring performance visibility from frontline operations through to executive leadership, and enabling data-informed decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.
Ensure enterprise leaders have clear, consistent, and actionable operational insights through structured reporting and effective translation of performance data into business implications and improvement priorities.
Support effective cross-functional governance and integration across Enterprise Operations, ensuring interdependencies are managed, information flows appropriately, and leaders are equipped to act quickly and cohesively.
Support Enterprise Operations leadership in responding to internal audit, risk, compliance, and regulatory requests relevant to operational performance, readiness, and issue resolution.
Build and lead a high-performing, engaged team, embedding a culture of accountability, responsiveness, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Extensive senior leadership experience in enterprise operations, onboarding, enrollment, implementation, solution configuration, or related functions, ideally within insurance, health, benefits administration, or financial services.
Extensive senior leadership experience in enterprise operations, onboarding, enrollment, implementation, solution configuration, or related functions, ideally within insurance, health, benefits administration, or financial services.
Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional operational processes at scale with accountability for quality, service, and business outcomes.
Proven experience driving transformation, standardization, and automation in large, matrixed organizations.
Strong understanding of operational risk, data accuracy, readiness, and the downstream impacts of onboarding and enrollment quality on client, member, and business outcomes.
Strong financial, operational, and analytical acumen, including experience managing operational performance, capacity, and service effectiveness.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and build trusted partnerships across functions and lines of business.
Experience leading, interpreting, and using operational metrics, dashboards, and performance reporting to improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making.
Experience overseeing complex issue resolution, service recovery, or enterprise escalation processes, with a focus on root-cause resolution and sustainable improvement.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

Leadership Behaviors

Results-focused, with the ability to balance pace, quality, and risk.
Leads with an end-to-end service mindset, understanding the impact of decisions and execution across the full client, member, and operational experience.
Drives consistency and quality, setting high standards for execution, follow-through, and operational discipline.
Creates accountable integration across teams, ensuring alignment, transparency, and coordinated action across functions and levels of the organization.
Brings strong ownership and accountability for outcomes, balancing pace, quality, risk, and sustainability.
Communicates clearly and proactively, translating operational complexity into practical direction, decisions, and action.
Builds trust and credibility through sound judgment, responsiveness, and a practical, solutions-oriented leadership style.
Leads people with clarity and care, creating an environment of inclusion, high expectations, and continuous improvement.

THE CULTURE

We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.

Where your growth means our growth.
Where your voice is heard and valued.
Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.

We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.

Here’s to Better Health for All!

A FEW MORE DETAILS

Proficiency in English is required for this position. As part of this role, you will be required to communicate with colleagues or customers who use English as their primary language. By requiring English proficiency for this position, we aim to ensure that our employees can excel in their roles, collaborate, and communicate effectively, and contribute to the success of our organization.

GS supports diversity, equity and inclusion in our teams and communities, and we value the unique contributions made by all. Eve

Our most important investment is in people. Upon eligibility, Raymond James Ltd offers flexible workstyles,
a competitive compensation and benefits package. Our benefits range from Health Benefits, RRSP Matching Program, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, Volunteer Days, Discretionary Bonuses, Tuition Reimbursement and many more! We also support internal promotion and community involvement.

What do we expect from you?

More than 10 years of relevant experience in tax, financial, estate, insurance and/or succession planning, including significant client-facing experience in wealth management or tax practice.
Demonstrated ability to design and implement complex, integrated planning strategies for high-net-worth clients.
Extensive knowledge of Canadian financial planning principles and their practical application.
University degree in business, finance, accounting or a related discipline.
Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation.
Recognized financial planning designation, such as CFP, R.F.P., F.Pl. for Quebec, or an equivalent credential.
Completion of the CPA Canada In-Depth Tax Program, Levels I and II, or a Master of Taxation is a strong asset.
Knowledge of U.S. financial planning is an asset.
Professional proficiency in French is an asset.

Additional Accreditations Considered As Asset

Trust and Estate Practitioner (TEP).
Family Enterprise Advisor (FEA).

Core Competencies

Exceptional integrity, judgement, discretion and professionalism when handling private and confidential client information.
Strong leadership and team-management capabilities, with the ability to guide others and manage multiple priorities.
Excellent relationship-building and client-service skills across in-person, videoconference and telephone interactions.
Clear, confident written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Financial Advisors, internal specialists and clients’ external tax and legal advisors.
Strong organization, time management, prioritization and attention to detail in a high-volume environment.
Ability to work independently, exercise initiative and contribute effectively within a team.
Commitment to ongoing professional development and to representing the Raymond James brand with professionalism.

Travel

Occasional travel may be required.
